```{python}
import sparknlp
spark = sparknlp.start()

ddr = spark.sparkContext.parallelize(range(10))

ddr = ddr.map(lambda x: x * 2)

ddr.collect()
```

Ça marche !

```{python}
from sparknlp.base import *
from sparknlp.annotator import *

document_assembler = (
  DocumentAssembler()
    .setInputCol("text")
    .setOutputCol("document")
)

sentence_detector = (
  SentenceDetector()
    .setInputCols(["document"])
    .setOutputCol("sentence")
)

pipeline = Pipeline(stages=[
  document_assembler,
  sentence_detector
])
```

```{python}
sentences = [
  ['Hello, this is an example sentence.'],
  ['And this is a second sentence. Then a third one.']
]

data = spark.createDataFrame(sentences, ["text"])

result = pipeline.fit(data).transform(data)

for row in result.collect():
    print(row)
```

Et ça marche encore !
